Context: Instructions for Pension Disbursing Authorities.-

- (vii) A family pensioner, other than spouse, has to submit a declaration of non-marriage/ non re-marriage every six months. If the spouse is a recipient of family pension, no certificate of remarriage is required to be furnished by him/her. At the time of commencement of family pension, an undertaking will be obtained from him/her to the effect that in the event of his/her remarriage, he/she will report the fact to the pension disbursing bank promptly.
